definition: [ שָׂחָה ] verb swim (Late Hebrew סָחוּ swimming ; Targum סְחָא , Syriac swim, bathe , also סָחְיָא , סַחְיָנָא , שָׂחְיָנָא swimmer ; Aph`el wash ); — Qal Participle + Infinitive construct כַּאֲשֶׁר יְפָרֵשׂ הַשּׂחֶה לִשְׂחוֺת Isa 25:11 . Hiph`il Imperfect 1 singular אַשְׂחֶה Ps 6:7 I make my bed swim (with my tears; another view below שִׂיחַ Qal 1 ).

[שָׂחָה] verb swim (Late Hebrew סָחוּ swimming; Targum סְחָא, Syriac swim, bathe, also סָחְיָא, סַחְיָנָא, שָׂחְיָנָא swimmer; Aph`el wash); —

Qal Participle + Infinitive construct כַּאֲשֶׁר יְפָרֵשׂ הַשּׂחֶה לִשְׂחוֺת Isa 25:11. Hiph`il Imperfect 1 singular אַשְׂחֶה Ps 6:7 I make my bed swim (with my tears; another view below שִׂיחַQal 1).
